Research_Gap: The available evidence does not establish how meristem signaling and stress-resilience processes interact over time.
The available evidence does not establish how genome stability and chromatin maintenance are coordinated during long-term meristem maintenance.
The available evidence does not establish whether autophagy, proteostasis and redox control operate as a coordinated quality-control system.
The available evidence does not establish which relationships are causal versus merely associated.
The available evidence does not establish functional conservation or translational equivalence between plant mechanisms and human cellular aging mechanisms.
